title: Anomalous objects seen by a Navy acoustic intelligence ship off Japan

tellings.quote: he was an acoustic specialist, retired as a captain, was on one of the Navy's acoustic intelligence ships off Japan. In two cases, they also observed these anomalous objects

plain: On a Navy ship off Japan whose job was gathering intelligence by listening underwater, the crew is said to have seen unexplained objects on two occasions. Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy rear admiral, passes this on from a man he knew, an acoustic specialist who retired as a Navy captain and served on one of those ships. Gallaudet tells it as more evidence that strange objects show up at sea.
